messages:
Samir: Heads up - egress circuitbreaker tripped in us-west-2, blocked keystore calls for a subset of gpu-warmup hosts. Observed ~30% warmup failures.
Jordan: saw that. Is this the new keystore penaltybox change rolled last night?
Samir: Yes. Rollout 02:30 UTC. Circuitbreaker threshold = 120 qps per az. Audit-shipper spiked and we hit the global egress quota, circuitbreaker routed to penaltybox.
Ashley: @Samir can you paste logs? any 5xx from keystore or just timeouts?
Samir: timeouts. sample logs:
```
2026-03-23T02:34:12Z keystore-proxy timeout for node gpu-node-42: dial tcp 10.0.5.42:443: i/o timeout
2026-03-23T02:34:13Z circuitbreaker tripped for keystore-usw2-azb
```
Lisa: Penaltybox means nodes cannot fetch ephemeral keys for disk decrypt, hence evictions/failed joins. We should avoid full eviction for warmups.
Jordan: Ops proposal: temporarily increase egress quota for audit-shipper, or relax circuitbreaker to 200 qps while we backfill logs. Cost impact estimate?
Pete: rough calc: +50% egress for 2hrs in us-west-2 ~= $2.5k. If we do a targeted whitelist for audit-shipper only maybe $1k.
Ashley: Can we short-circuit audit-shipper to S3 in the region to reduce keystore calls? There's a flag in config.
Samir: yes, can flip --audit-direct-s3=true but need a quick PR and canary. I can do it now, will need @Jordan to approve.
Jordan: approve. Do it staged: canary 10% -> monitor kv-cache hit rate and join success.
Deploy-bot: deploy started by Samir at 02:51 UTC: canary 10% audit-direct-s3
Samir: Canary shows warmup success back to baseline, keystore latency back to normal, circuitbreaker no longer tripping.
Lisa: Follow-ups: 1) tighten audit-shipper backpressure 2) add metric for egress-circuitbreaker-penaltybox-rate 3) engineering change to avoid evict on ephemeral-keystore timeouts for warmup tier.
Jordan: I'll open JIRA ENGINFRA-7893 for the policy change. Samir will add PR for audit-direct-s3 toggle and long-term fix.
Samir: PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/keystore-proxy/pull/512 — will merge after tests.
Pete: We'll bill this to incident ops budget — agree to keep cost threshold at $3k for emergency egress increases.
Ashley: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll add note to runbook under "egress penaltybox" with steps we took.
Samir: marking thread resolved once PR merged and metrics stable.
